# BentoPDF

A privacy-first PDF toolkit: merge, split, compress, convert and edit PDFs in the browser, with no upload to a server.

## What it is

**What it is:** a PDF toolbox that runs entirely in your browser. The server only delivers the web app (static files); merging, splitting, compressing, converting and editing happen on your own device, so documents are never uploaded.

**Sub-tags:** office (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Image:** upstream `ghcr.io/alam00000/bentopdf:v2.8.11`, an nginx image whose `nginx` user is UID/GID 101 and which listens on port 8080 (no privileged port). This package starts it as UID 101.
- **State:** none. The pod is stateless; there is no volume to back up.
- **Health:** startup, readiness and liveness probes on `GET /`, which answers 200 while nginx serves the app.
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token.

## First run

1. Open the web UI (port 8080) from the OneMind dashboard.
2. Pick a tool and drop in a PDF. Nothing needs to be set up.

## Known limits in this package

- No volume: nothing is stored on the server, by design.
- Licence: AGPL-3.0 (GitHub licence API). There is no research licence-matrix row yet (brief 30 B10), so the gate notes that the app is not preinstallable on sold boxes.
<!-- onemind:notes:end -->
